chapter_notes: Skipped 2 non-receptor/non-enzyme statements (TRPV1 cation-permeable channel activated by capsaicin; generic TRPV1 receptor-antagonist mention, with capsazepine used as a TRPV1 blocker but not described as such on the page). The book calls TRPV1 'the capsaicin receptor', but describes it as mediating influx of cations, so it was treated as an ion channel and not recorded.
